Locale and time zone are pinned by scripts/oracle/l1/core/renderer/locale.ts, loaded before the app module: process.env.TZ = 'UTC', and Intl.RelativeTimeFormat, Date.prototype.toLocaleString and String.prototype.localeCompare get 'en-US' when the app passes undefined (toLocaleString also gets timeZone 'UTC'), as the UI captures run. Node's own ICU (Node 24.13.1, ICU 78.2, CLDR 48.0) produces the text.
toLocaleString with dateStyle 'medium' and timeStyle 'short'. The out strings are ICU's exactly, separators included (this ICU puts a plain space before AM and PM, where some ICU versions put U+202F). Years before 1 are shown without an era: ISO year -1 prints as 2.
